results.title: History persists after activity restart and can restore an expression
results.expected: History shows 1+1 = 2 and restores the expression
results.actual: history=History · 7 | Clear | Close history | = 0.3 | 200+10% | 27th Oct, 08:59 | = 220 | √(9) | = 3 | sin(30) | = 0.5 | 1+1 | 27th Oct, 09:00 | = 2; restored=CALCULATOR | 1+1 | = 2
results.comment: The history entry survived process restart and restored its expression.

results.title: Grouped history card restores and re-evaluates without Error
results.expected: History card re-evaluates to 123457 without Error
results.comment: The grouped expression was restored and evaluated successfully; display commas did not contaminate the calculation.

results.title: Chained calculations retain unrounded precision
results.comment: After 1 ÷ 3 =, the UI result was ['CALCULATOR', '0.3333333333']; multiplying by 3 did not return 1. This is consistent with the screen feeding its rounded display string back into the next expression.

results.title: Scientific-notation result can be used in the next expression
results.comment: Initial 10^15 display was ['CALCULATOR', '1e+15']; adding +1 left an unchanged exponent result or produced Error. This is consistent with exponent-formatted display text not being accepted as a numeric literal by the expression validator/parser.
